name: flaggems_bitwise_left_shift_
description: In-place elementwise bitwise left shift (Tensor.bitwise_left_shift_) extracted from FlagGems pytest. Operates in place on integer tensors and returns the mutated tensor.
reference:
import torch


def gen_inputs(ctx, device):
    a_shape = ctx["a__shape"]
    a_dtype = getattr(torch, ctx["a__dtype"])
    b_shape = ctx["b__shape"]
    b_dtype = getattr(torch, ctx["b__dtype"])
    a = torch.randint(0, 100, a_shape, dtype=a_dtype, device=device)
    b = torch.randint(0, 8, b_shape, dtype=b_dtype, device=device)
    return {"a": a, "b": b}


def run(a, b):
    a.bitwise_left_shift_(b)
    return a
